meta.readMe: The pool is the top DPS rankings for one spec, which biases it toward fast kills: a mechanic that only appears late may be under-represented or absent, and 'journalOnly' lists catalogued abilities the pool never cast. Times are given both from the pull start (atSeconds) and from the start of the phase segment they landed in (atSegmentSeconds); the second is the stable one. A segment index is not a phase number -- phases repeat, so read phaseId/cycle.

journal.title: Blighted Blood
journal.description: The Blood of Ula'tek infects players with blood venom, inflicting 208352 Shadow damage every 2 sec for 18 sec.

journal.title: Bloodvenom Injection
journal.description: The Blood of Ula'tek injects its current target with a blood venom, inflicting 2500220 Physical damage immediately with an additional 41670 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 40 sec. This effect stacks.

journal.title: Contaminate
journal.description: The Venom Coagulation continually radiates a contaminating essence, inflicting 116677 Nature damage to all players every 3 sec.

journal.title: Empowering Slam
journal.description: The Breath of Ula'tek slams its current target, inflicting 2500220 Physical damage. Each time the golem slams the same target, it empowers itself and gains 10% additional Physical damage dealt until it slams a different target.

journal.title: Shifting Protovenom
journal.description:
Vashnik contaminates random players with a prototype venom, inflicting 233354 Plague damage every 2 sec.

Coming into contact with another Protovenom neutralizes them harmlessly, while colliding with an uncontaminated player causes a Protovenom Eruption.

journal.title: Toxic Droplets
journal.description: The Breath of Ula'tek sprays forth many toxic droplets, which each erupt into Noxious Blast after 12 sec. Players can destroy the droplets by stepping on top of them, suffering 375033 Nature damage.

journal.title: Unstable Miasma
journal.description: The Blood of Ula'tek marks a player with unstable miasma. After 8 sec, the miasma erupts, inflicting 5000440 Shadow damage split evenly among players within 7.5 yards. This impact spreads applications of Clinging Murk among the targets struck.

journal.title: Venom Coagulation
journal.description: The Breath of Ula'tek vomits up a sticky mass of venom that animates itself into a living slime.

journal.title: Vitriolic Stasis
journal.description: Upon reaching 100 energy, both Sentinels rush together and begin to balance their fluid levels over 30 sec. This process reduces their damage taken by 99% and restores health to the weaker Sentinel until it matches the other.
